papers.abstract: Foundation models increasingly guide robot actions, yet sustained autonomy requires efficient control and failure recovery. We introduce A2-MEAS, an embodied multi-agent framework built around code as a scaling interface. Learned correction codes combine corrective language, spatial evidence, execution history, and action proposals. MetaBrain provides training supervision and runtime guidance. A correction encoder and adapter absorb this knowledge into policy weights during training, while fresh codes adapt behavior with frozen weights at deployment. The action model, A2-WLA, adds motion-aware history and a latent world model to a vision-language-action policy. Surprisingly, this simple design with action pretraining and task specialization reaches 0.5755 Q-score on the 50-task BEHAVIOR 2026 public subset before online correction, 2.21x the 2025 winner's reported 0.2605 across different benchmark editions and training configurations. On all 100 BEHAVIOR 2026 public tasks, A2-MEAS achieves 0.6411 Q-score and 45.40% task success. On RoboTwin 2.0, A2-WLA achieves 93.98% average success, rising to 95.05% with the complete system. Across 12 real-robot tasks in five household settings, A2-WLA achieves 57.92% average success versus 26.67% for pi0.5. In long-horizon pour-over coffee preparation, a history-conditioned adapter raises post-failure completion at two filter-handling steps from 14% to 94% and from 8% to 82%, compared with A2-WLA retries. Our training infrastructure delivers 427.1 samples per second, 4.03x the throughput of a pi0.5 reference implementation on matched hardware. We will release the system, models, training scripts, and infrastructure to support efficient embodied learning.

analysis.key_results: 在BEHAVIOR 2026 50任务上Q-score达0.5755（获奖基线2.21倍），100任务上Q-score 0.6411、成功率45.40%；RoboTwin 2.0平均成功率93.98%（完整系统95.05%）；12个真实机器人任务平均成功率57.92%（对比pi0.5的26.67%）；长程咖啡任务中后故障完成率从14%提升至94%和从8%提升至82%；训练吞吐427.1样本/秒，为pi0.5参考实现的4.03倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出A2-MEAS具身多智能体框架，利用学习型纠正代码、潜在世界模型和历史感知的视觉-语言-动作策略（A2-WLA）实现机器人动作的精准控制与失败恢复。
analysis.method: 使用代码作为扩展接口，结合纠正编码器、MetaBrain训练监督、适配器权重吸收，以及运动感知历史和潜在世界模型增强的视觉-语言-动作策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出了一种基于代码作为扩展接口、结合潜在世界模型和运动感知历史的具身多智能体框架A2-MEAS，显著提升了机器人在多个基准和真实任务中的表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接聚焦于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型在机器人操控中的应用，通过引入潜在世界模型增强动作预测和失败恢复，并实现高效的训练与推理，与本站VLA和WAM主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Long-video question answering forces multimodal large language models to reason under strict visual-token budgets, creating a tradeoff between broad temporal coverage and fine-grained spatial detail. Uniform sampling preserves coverage but often obscures decisive local cues, while caption-based or frame-similarity retrieval operates over lossy proxies that can miss motion, state changes, and before-after relations. We recast long-video reasoning as a visual-token allocation problem: given a fixed budget, decide how much to spend on global context versus high-resolution local evidence, and where in the video to draw that local evidence from. We introduce AdaAlloc, a training-free inference framework that adaptively allocates visual tokens between a global video overview and localized visual detail. AdaAlloc first plans a global/local allocation policy, then uses temporal grounding to locate candidate evidence segments and refines them into a compact temporal memory. The selected policy controls both frame sampling density and resolution, combining sparse, lower-resolution global frames with denser, higher-resolution local frames drawn from the refined memory. The final answerer reasons over the allocated global context and refined local evidence. Across LVBench, MLVU, VideoMME, and LongVideoBench, AdaAlloc improves over budget-matched uniform sampling by up to 10.5 percentage points and outperforms the compared frame-selection and agentic methods on their reported benchmarks.

analysis.key_results: 在LVBench、MLVU、VideoMME和LongVideoBench上，AdaAlloc比预算匹配的均匀采样提升最多10.5个百分点，并优于对比的帧选择和智能体方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出AdaAlloc，一种无训练的自适应视觉令牌分配框架，通过全局/局部分配策略和时序定位来优化视觉令牌预算的使用。
analysis.method: AdaAlloc首先规划全局/局部分配策略，利用时序定位找到候选证据片段并压缩为紧凑时序记忆，然后根据策略控制帧采样密度和分辨率，最后在全局上下文和局部证据上进行推理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种无训练的自适应视觉令牌分配框架，在长视频问答中平衡全局覆盖与局部细节，提升推理性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文关注长视频问答中的高效推理和视觉令牌分配，属于视觉-语言模型的效率优化；与VLA（视觉-语言-动作）和WAM（世界模型）无直接关系，但其自适应令牌分配思想可能对多模态机器人策略的有限算力推理有借鉴意义。

papers.abstract: Face Anti-Spoofing (FAS) must distinguish genuine faces from presentation attacks. A unified Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) is an attractive solution: it detects physical attacks (print, replay, mask) in one model and produces interpretable forensic evidence via Chain-of-Thought (CoT). A central obstacle to post-training such a model with reinforcement learning is that FAS reasoning has no rule-verifiable ground truth: only the binary verdict is checkable, while the reasoning chain cannot be verified by any hand-crafted rule. Optimizing the verdict alone is therefore a sparse, hackable signal. The model can reach the correct answer through a shortcut such as a false-rejection bias, which does not generalize. We address this with a grounding-aware judge reward. A 32B vision-language judge scores each reasoning chain against the image on evidence anchoring, logical coherence, and domain knowledge, turning the image itself into the verification signal. The reward is applied in a Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) stage after CoT supervised fine-tuning. It is the judge, rather than the RL objective, that supplies the process supervision a verdict-only reward cannot. Our study starts from a model that already performs well In-Domain (ID) after CoT-based supervised fine-tuning and asks how to improve its Out-of-Domain (OOD) generalization. We find that grounding-aware rewards are an effective means to that end. We validate the method on OOD generalization, where the reward reduces ACER on two physical benchmarks (LCC-FASD 0.288 to 0.273, MSU-MFSD 0.431 to 0.409) while preserving ID accuracy (CelebA-Spoof 0.033 to 0.035). Against ResNet-50/101 and CLIP-ViT-B/16 baselines, the MLLM dominates ID and matches or surpasses the strongest baseline OOD. To our knowledge this is the first use of LLM-as-judge process supervision for FAS.

analysis.key_results: 在域外基准上ACER降低：LCC-FASD从0.288降至0.273，MSU-MFSD从0.431降至0.409，同时保持域内精度（CelebA-Spoof从0.033变为0.035）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种基于32B视觉语言模型的接地感知评判奖励，用于强化学习过程监督，以提升人脸防伪模型的域外泛化能力。
analysis.method: 采用接地感知评判奖励结合Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)，在CoT监督微调后对视觉语言模型进行强化学习训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出一种接地感知评判奖励的强化学习方法，用以提升人脸防伪模型在域外场景的泛化能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于人脸防伪领域，使用视觉语言模型和强化学习，虽与本站主题的视觉语言和强化学习部分有方法论上的关联，但未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人世界模型，无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Language-guided embodied person tracking requires a mobile agent to identify a target from a referring description and consistently follow the target under egocentric observations. We present DobotTrack, a target-grounded vision-language-action (VLA) framework that integrates auxiliary grounding supervision with efficient temporal modeling. We systematically investigate five auxiliary tasks---person segmentation, bounding-box grounding, visual-spatial classification (VSC), future DINO feature prediction, and future-frame prediction---and adopt complementary mask and bounding-box supervision to enhance target delineation and localization. We introduce Q-identity, a target-conditioned historical visual compression module that leverages target-grounding predictions to selectively preserve identity-discriminative appearance features and spatial cues in compact historical tokens. On EVT-Bench, our 0.8B-parameter model achieves an average success rate of 77.9%, exceeding OmTrackVLA by 16.9 percentage points across the three tasks. We further construct a real-world person-tracking dataset collected using a quadruped robot, comprising 126 episodes and 596,323 mask-annotated frames. The target masks enable automatic derivation of bounding boxes and visual-spatial labels encoding horizontal position and apparent image scale, providing additional grounding supervision without separate manual annotation of these labels. Together, our framework and annotation pipeline support learning target-grounded tracking policies from simulated and real-world data. Code is available at https://github.com/Dobot-Team/dobot_track.

analysis.key_results: 在EVT-Bench上，0.8B参数模型平均成功率达77.9%，超过OmTrackVLA 16.9个百分点；构建了包含126个片段和596,323帧掩码标注的四足机器人真实世界人物跟踪数据集。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DobotTrack框架，集成辅助接地监督和高效时序建模，并引入Q-identity目标条件历史视觉压缩模块，提升目标识别与定位能力。
analysis.method: 采用目标基视觉-语言-动作框架，结合五种辅助任务（人物分割、边界框接地、视觉空间分类、未来DINO特征预测、未来帧预测）进行监督，并通过Q-identity模块选择性保留身份判别性外观特征和空间线索。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出目标基视觉-语言-动作框架DobotTrack，通过辅助接地监督和高效时序建模实现具身人物跟踪。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对VLA在具身机器人人物跟踪任务中的应用，提出了结合视觉接地与动作学习的策略，对移动机器人跟踪策略学习具有直接价值。

figures.caption: Challenges in language-guided embodied person tracking. (a) Distractors and occlusion complicate target grounding in the robot’s limited field of view. (b) Dense visual histories increase inference cost, while indiscriminate pooling can discard target-specific cues. (c) Median inference latency on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano (FP16, batch size 1, including the visual encoder; 90 measurements per point) increases with the total input token count. Reducing the token count from 2048 to 256 lowers latency by approximately 52%, motivating target-conditioned history compression for on-device deployment.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of DobotTrack and Q-identity. Left: the VLA processes a target description, current-frame visual tokens, and compressed historical tokens to predict target grounding and future waypoints. Target-grounding predictions guide historical visual compression for subsequent decisions. Right: Q-identity aggregates target-region features and full-image context through joint query–target self-attention, full-image cross-attention, and feed-forward updates. The resulting compact historical tokens are fed back into the VLA’s visual input.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.abstract: Creative tool use is a fundamental human capability and an important step toward general-purpose embodied intelligence. It requires agents to reason about object affordances, physical constraints, and manipulation strategies, especially when standard tools are unavailable. However, progress in this area is limited by the lack of real-world datasets that capture human tool-use behavior with sufficient scale, fidelity, and diversity. Existing benchmarks are often simulation-based, focus on simplified interactions, or lack detailed observations and annotations. We introduce ToolDex, a large-scale egocentric-exocentric (ego-exo) human demonstration dataset for creative physical tool use. ToolDex captures scenarios in which humans select, adapt, and repurpose available objects as tools. Using synchronized egocentric cameras and eight exocentric cameras, the dataset provides high-fidelity multi-view observations and rich annotations for hands, tools, target objects, and their deformable interactions. Beyond data collection, we establish a benchmark suite characterizing three core capabilities: physical tool-use reasoning, sparse-view 3D and 4D reconstruction, and robot policy learning. ToolDex provides a foundation for studying human tool-use behavior and developing embodied agents that can adaptively use tools in complex real-world environments. Dataset visualizations and benchmarking results are available at https://tooluse-dataset.github.io/.

analysis.method: 通过同步自视角摄像头和八个外视角摄像头采集多视角数据，记录人类选择、改编和重新利用可用物体作为工具的过程，并提供手、工具、目标物体及变形交互的详细标注。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ToolDex是一个大规模自视角-外视角人类示范数据集，旨在研究创造性物理工具使用，并为物理工具使用推理、稀疏视角重建和机器人策略学习提供基准。

papers.abstract: Large vision-language-action (VLA) models generalize well but are difficult to run in real time on a robot, and small VLAs that run there fail more often. Remote inference over beyond-5G and 6G networks lets a robot use a large VLA on a server, but querying the server for every action chunk limits the number of robots per server. We propose VLA handover: the robot runs a small VLA (S-VLA) and switches to a large VLA (L-VLA) on a server only when the S-VLA is likely to fail. We formulate the switching as minimizing the request cost under a required success probability and, since this problem cannot be solved directly, propose a heuristic framework that retrains neither VLA. In simulation with SmolVLA and $\pi_{0.5}$ on three of the four LIBERO suites, VLA handover raised the success rate by 11-22 percentage points over the S-VLA alone and sent 49-77% fewer requests than server-only control at a 2-4 percentage-point lower success rate, and its completion time grew less with the network latency.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO三个套件上，与单独小VLA相比成功率提升11-22个百分点；与仅用服务器大VLA相比，请求减少49-77%，成功率低2-4个百分点，且完成时间随网络延迟增长更慢。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出VLA handover框架，在不重新训练两个VLA的情况下，通过失败预测动态切换小VLA和大VLA。
analysis.method: 将切换问题建模为在满足所需成功概率下最小化请求成本，并利用启发式框架进行决策。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出VLA handover框架，机载小VLA在预测到可能失败时切换至服务器大VLA，以降低请求成本并维持成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接关注VLA模型，通过小模型与大模型的切换实现高效推理，对机器人实时控制有实际价值，与本站VLA主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: We present RevoSim, a scalable and high-fidelity multimodal tactile simulator for the BrainCo Revo3 hand that jointly models 285 piezoresistive taxels and five visuotactile fingertips. RevoSim efficiently generates synchronized pressure, depth, RGB, and marker-displacement observations; on a single RTX 5090, its depth-conditioned marker-displacement configuration supports up to 4,096 parallel environments. We train in-hand manipulation and grasping policies entirely in simulation, establishing a foundation for future sim-to-real transfer. Project page: https://braincotech.github.io/RevoSim-web/.

analysis.key_results: RevoSim 可高效生成同步的多种触觉观测；深度条件标记位移配置支持最多 4096 个并行环境；已在仿真中完全训练手内操作和抓取策略。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 RevoSim，一个可扩展、高保真的多模态触觉仿真器，联合建模 285 个压阻触觉单元和五个视觉触觉指尖，并支持大规模并行仿真。
analysis.method: 构建多模态触觉仿真环境，联合建模压阻触觉单元与视觉触觉指尖，同步生成压力、深度、RGB 和标记位移观测；利用深度条件标记位移配置在单个 RTX 5090 上支持高达 4096 个并行环境。

papers.abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) is the most reliable way to obtain accurate low-bit large language models (LLMs), but training with AdamW keeps two dense FP32 states for every weight matrix. We find that low-rank memory-efficient optimizers such as GaLore and LDAdam degrade substantially in QAT. A considerable part of the QAT momentum lies outside its top-r singular subspace, and projection-based methods discard this part at every step. We further observe that this residual remains useful when only its sign is kept. Based on these observations, we propose ResQAdam. It keeps a single BF16 momentum, applies Adam only to the r x r coordinates of the principal subspace, and adds a normalized sign update computed from the residual. We evaluate ResQAdam with two from-scratch QAT methods and three QAT fine-tuning pipelines, with weights quantized down to 2 bits. It reduces optimizer-state memory by 71% to 74% relative to AdamW, stays close to AdamW in most settings, and lowers training throughput by less than 2%.

analysis.key_results: 在多种从头训练和微调设置下，优化器状态内存较AdamW减少71%-74%，大多数设置下精度接近AdamW，训练吞吐量降低少于2%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ResQAdam优化器，保留单一BF16动量、对主子空间应用Adam并对残差进行归一化符号更新，在量化感知训练中减少71%-74%优化器状态内存。
analysis.method: ResQAdam：保留低秩投影残差的符号信息，仅在主要子空间的r×r坐标上应用Adam，从而在量化感知训练中降低优化器内存开销。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出ResQAdam优化器，通过保留低秩投影残差的符号更新，在量化感知训练中大幅减少优化器内存占用且保持模型精度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于低比特量化感知训练中的内存高效优化器，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人世界模型；但作为量化技术，未来可用于降低VLA或WAM模型的训练与推理内存需求。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models promise a single language-conditioned policy adaptable to many manipulation behaviors, yet deployment additionally requires skill retention and long-horizon composition: a policy must retain previously acquired skills and reuse them inside composite tasks whose behavior changes across phases. The standard recipe absorbs every new task into one shared update, which provides neither a parameter-level locus for reusable skills nor a mechanism for invoking each skill along the trajectory. We observe that this missing structure is latent rather than absent: per-skill low-rank updates of a pretrained VLA occupy a robustly distinguishable, low-dimensional subspace, and a single composite-task LoRA concentrates roughly half of its Frobenius energy in this subspace, against a near-zero matched random-rotation control. Building on this geometry, we introduce PRISM, which represents reusable skills as parameter-level primitives: each skill family is stored as a dedicated low-rank action-expert adapter in a primitive bank, primitives are augmented with skill-specific low-rank residuals and composed at inference by a per-chunk VLM-conditioned router that reads the prefix representation to track task progress, and the router is supervised by per-chunk labels from a deterministic, task-conditioned, action-derived oracle. During composite training, the vision encoder, the language LoRA, the skill residuals, the router, and the shared action projections and time MLP are updated; every primitive is held frozen, so the base per-skill action-expert adapters are preserved by construction. On RoboCasa365, PRISM achieves 56.43% atomic-skill success and reaches 20.00% on long-horizon composite tasks, while a standard $\pi_{0.5}$-LoRA two-stage fine-tune reaches 17.86% atomic and 17.50% composite success. We additionally validate PRISM on an AgileX PIPER real-robot setup.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboCasa365上，PRISM原子技能成功率为56.43%，长程组合任务成功率为20.00%，而标准π0.5-LoRA两阶段微调分别为17.86%和17.50%；并在AgileX PIPER真实机器人上验证。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PRISM框架，将可重用技能表示为参数级原语（低秩动作专家适配器），并通过VLM条件路由器组合原语，实现VLA模型的技能保留与长程组合。
analysis.method: 构建技能原语银行，每类技能存储为专用低秩动作专家适配器，并增强技能特定的低秩残差；推理时由基于前缀表示的每块VLM条件路由器组合原语，路由器由确定性、任务条件、动作衍生的oracle标签监督。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PRISM将技能表示为参数级原语，通过低秩适配器和路由器实现VLA模型在长程组合任务中的技能保留与重用。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对VLA模型的持续适应与技能组合问题，提出参数级原语路由方法，与VLA主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Recent progress in embodied robotics is bringing robots closer to deployment in homes, as vision-language models (VLMs) are demonstrating significant advances in reasoning, making VLM-driven robots promising home assistant agents. These agents will often be introduced into homes that already have cameras, Internet of Things (IoT) devices, and residents with wearables. To fulfill their potential, they need to integrate with existing smart infrastructure and reason through ambiguous scenarios: a smoke alarm may come from a pan about to ignite, a pan already on fire, a resident cooking or a faulty sensor, and each calls for a different response. To that end, we introduce HomeLoop, a simulation framework and benchmark built on Isaac Sim that combines robot bodies, networked devices and wearables, simulated residents and visitors, faulty sensors, and hazards that evolve over time. Our benchmark is composed of 20 tasks across five families grounded in real-world household hazards and needs, and designed so that the same alert can have different causes. A runtime monitor scores each episode with temporal-logic checks on the final outcome and the actions along the way, and every action carries a predefined cost. We evaluate six open-weight and proprietary VLMs. The best achieves a family-balanced score of 61.9%, and across models we see a pattern of over-reaction: failed episodes involving prohibited interventions outnumber those involving missed required interventions by more than two to one, with models often shutting off the stove before investigating the alarm's cause. HomeLoop is an extensible foundation intended for use in research on robot-IoT coordination, long-term memory, proactive assistance, and privacy-safety trade-offs. HomeLoop will be released with 2,100 home layouts that can be automatically furnished in diverse configurations, five robot bodies and 20 networked device types.

analysis.key_results: 评估了6个开源和闭源VLM，最佳模型家族平衡得分为61.9%；模型普遍过度反应，失败场景中禁止干预的次数是遗漏必要干预的两倍以上，常在不调查报警原因的情况下就关闭炉灶。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了HomeLoop仿真框架和基准，包含20个任务、5类真实家庭隐患场景、2100个可自动布置的户型、5种机器人本体和20种联网设备，并配备基于时序逻辑的运行时监控和动作成本评分。
analysis.method: 在Isaac Sim中构建集成机器人、物联网设备、可穿戴设备、模拟居民、故障传感器和动态隐患的仿真环境，定义任务并用时序逻辑检查最终结果和过程动作，评估VLMs。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: HomeLoop是一个基于Isaac Sim的仿真框架与基准，用于评估视觉语言模型驱动的家用机器人在与现有智能家居设备协同处理动态家庭隐患和日常任务中的表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该基准旨在评估视觉语言模型在真实家庭环境中的推理和决策能力，涉及机器人动作与安全约束，与VLA和世界模型的评测相关，但核心是基准构建与评估，不直接研究VLA或WAM的算法改进。

papers.abstract: Reliable relative tracking is fundamental to cooperative autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs), yet remains challenging under nonlinear vehicle dynamics and degraded underwater visual conditions. Active light markers improve robustness to appearance variation, but provide deliberately sparse observations that can become incomplete or corrupted by occlusion, reflections, and detection noise during dynamic motion. To address the resulting partial-observation control problem, this paper proposes FATHOM, a world-model-guided diffusion action-trajectory selection framework for sparse-marker AUV tracking. FATHOM first integrates structured marker observations, inertial measurements, action history, and temporal dynamics into a predictive tracking belief using a multimodal task-supervised recurrent state-space model. A diffusion action prior then generates multiple expert-like multi-thruster trajectories, whose future tracking consequences are predicted through the learned latent dynamics. Rather than directly executing a generated trajectory, FATHOM selects the most favorable candidate under an explicit receding-horizon objective and continually updates the decision from onboard observations. Extensive offline analyses verify the learned predictive belief, multi-step world-model prediction, diffusion trajectory generation, and predictive selection. More importantly, comprehensive real-AUV experiments, including strong pose-based comparisons and component ablations, demonstrate robust autonomous tracking across nominal and challenging motions with naturally occurring partial marker visibility, while maintaining real-time onboard operation without motion-capture feedback.

analysis.key_results: 广泛的离线分析验证了预测性信念、多步世界模型预测、扩散轨迹生成和预测选择；真实AUV实验表明在标称和挑战性运动及自然发生的部分标记可见性下实现鲁棒自主跟踪，并保持实时机载运行。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FATHOM，一种世界模型引导的扩散动作轨迹选择框架，通过预测性跟踪信念和显式滚动时域目标选择最优动作轨迹，实现部分观测下的鲁棒相对跟踪。
analysis.method: 首先利用多模态任务监督的循环状态空间模型整合稀疏标记观测、惯性测量、动作历史和时序动态，构建预测性跟踪信念；然后通过扩散动作先验生成多条专家式多推进器轨迹，并利用学习到的潜在动态预测未来跟踪结果；最后基于滚动时域目标选择最优候选轨迹。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出FATHOM框架，利用世界模型引导的扩散动作轨迹选择，解决稀疏标记AUV在部分观测下的跟踪控制问题。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文以世界模型（WAM）为核心，将其用于机器人动作选择（轨迹生成与评估），直接涉及世界建模与策略学习的结合，属于本站WAM主题的高度相关研究，且针对真实机器人系统进行验证。

papers.abstract: Operators can state safety constraints for robots as prohibitions such as "do not put the bowl on the stove". We study whether OpenVLA follows such prohibitions and where it represents the goal it executes. The 10 tasks of LIBEROGoal share one scene, so we can label the goal that each rollout executes. We combine closed-loop rollouts with activation patching, linear probes, activation steering and runtime monitors. On LIBERO-Goal, negation had no detectable effect on which task OpenVLA executed. The model executed the forbidden task in 79% of negated rollouts and completed 78% of plain tasks. A goal probe gives similar read-outs under "not X" and "X". Activation patching shows that the first action depends mostly on the instruction tokens before layer 12 and on the last prompt token from layer 16 onward. A fixed steering vector at the instruction tokens at layer 8 redirected 12 of 18 rollouts. Fixed vectors and prefill patches at layers 12 to 20 redirected none of 158. From layer 16, only patches at every decoded action token redirected the robot (15 of 18 rollouts at layer 24). When the instruction changes during a rollout, the layer-32 goal read-out detects non-compliance better than failure detectors, and an external probe on image and instruction features performs comparably. These results support enforcing prohibitions outside the instruction and monitoring goal read-outs against the specification. Goal edits in OpenVLA should act before layer 12 or patch every action token.

analysis.key_results: 在否定指令下，模型执行被禁止任务的比例达79%，普通任务完成率为78%；目标探针在“not X”与“X”下读数相似；层8指令令牌的固定引导向量使18次中12次改向，层16以后仅解码动作令牌的修补有效（层24时18次中15次改向）；层32目标读数比失败检测器更早检测到指令改变后的不遵循。
analysis.main_contribution: 揭示了OpenVLA在否定指令下仍执行被禁止任务的机制，并通过多层定位与编辑实验指出目标表征的执行阶段和可编辑位置。
analysis.method: 在LIBERO-Goal上进行闭环评测，结合激活修补、线性探针、激活引导和运行时监视，分析指令令牌和动作令牌在不同层对任务执行的影响。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究OpenVLA对否定式安全指令的遵循情况，并通过激活动作修补、线性探针和激活引导等方法定位其执行目标表征。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接研究OpenVLA这一VLA模型的目标表征定位与编辑，对通过外部安全约束或运行时监视方法提升VLA在真实操作中的指令遵循性具有直接价值。

papers.title: Localizing and Editing the Goal Representation of a Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.title_zh: 定位与编辑视觉-语言-动作模型的目标表征

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) map language instructions and visual observations to robot actions, showing strong capabilities across robotic manipulation tasks. However, in our probing experiment, we find that action representations near the action output do not fully preserve task-relevant visual grounding. Motivated by this late-layer grounding gap, we introduce STAR, for STeering Action Representations, a training-free inference method for pre-trained VLAs. STAR applies an exponential moving average over late-layer residual updates, allowing later action representations to inherit object-aware update directions from earlier layers without model updates or architectural changes. It further uses recent proprioceptive states to adapt the mixing strength, using conservative mixing when execution dynamics change rapidly. Experiments on robot manipulation benchmarks show that STAR improves late-layer object awareness and increases average task success rates by 4.0 percentage points. Our code is available at https://github.com/PKU-VaLuE-Lab/STAR.

analysis.key_results: 机器人操作基准测试显示，STAR提升了晚期层的物体感知，平均任务成功率提高4.0个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出STAR，一种无需训练的推理方法，通过引导动作表示来改善预训练VLA的视觉接地，提升机器人操作任务的成功率。
analysis.method: 对晚期残差更新应用指数移动平均，使动作表示继承早期层的物体感知更新方向，并利用最近的本体感觉状态调整混合强度。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种无需训练的推理方法STAR，通过指数移动平均引导动作表示，增强VLA在机器人操作中的视觉接地能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接针对VLA模型的推理方法，旨在增强动作预测中的视觉接地，属于VLA核心主题，对机器人操作性能有实际提升。

papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising approach to learning generalist robot policies using rich spatiotemporal priors from pre-trained video diffusion models. A recent line of WAMs improves inference efficiency by conditioning a separate action decoder on intermediate future video representations extracted from a single denoising step, avoiding costly iterative denoising required for video generation. This design makes action prediction depend directly on the quality of these future representations. In this paper, we introduce Future REpresentation learning via self-Distillation with temporal context (FRED), a framework that trains WAMs to improve the quality of future video representations from noise in a single denoising step. Specifically, FRED uses self-distillation to predict future representations from noise, using representations extracted from ground-truth future observations as targets. We further condition the video model on historical observations, providing temporal context for predicting future representations better. Across diverse real-world manipulation scenarios, FRED consistently outperforms competing WAMs. It achieves particularly large gains on long-horizon and out-of-domain tasks under zero-shot environment generalization, and substantially improves human-to-robot skill transfer, reaching 50.0% task success on tasks absent from robot training data and demonstrated only in human videos, compared with 19.4% for the best competing WAM.

analysis.key_results: 在多样化真实世界操作场景中一致优于竞争WAM；在长时程和分布外零样本泛化任务上提升显著；人机技能迁移任务成功率达到50.0%，而最佳对比方法仅19.4%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FRED，一种基于时间上下文的自蒸馏框架，训练WAM从单步去噪中预测更高质量的未来视频表示，无需迭代视频生成。
analysis.method: 使用自蒸馏，以真实未来观测的表示为靶标，从噪声预测未来表示；并基于历史观测对视频模型进行条件化以提供时间上下文。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出FRED框架，通过自蒸馏从噪声中一步预测未来视频表示，以提升世界动作模型的推理效率和动作预测质量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心主题为世界动作模型（WAM），通过改进未来视频表示学习来提升WAM的动作预测质量和推理效率，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: World models trained via latent dynamics offer a scalable path for embodied planning, yet existing methods suffer from representational collapse, computational overhead, and limited long-horizon capability. We introduce Memory World Model (MemWM), an associative memory-enhanced latent world model that augments JEPA-style prediction with a content-addressable memory bank. MemWM learns high-level historical representations directly from observations and leverages them to condition predictions via adaptive layer normalization, complementing low-level action-conditioned dynamics within a shared latent space. To prevent memory slots from collapsing into identical representations, we propose two complementary losses that encourage structural diversity across slots and balanced utilization across timesteps. On PushT, TwoRoom, Reacher, and OGBCube, MemWM attains an average success rate of 89.9%, matching DINO-WM (89.3%) while using roughly 4$\times$ fewer trainable parameters and no pretrained encoder, and improving over LeWM by 4.1%. Additionally, we extend the horizon to 50 timesteps, double the 25 timesteps of the original evaluation, demonstrating MemWM's robustness to long-horizon generalization.

analysis.key_results: 在 PushT、TwoRoom、Reacher 和 OGBCube 上平均成功率达 89.9%，与 DINO-WM 持平，但参数减少约 4 倍且无需预训练编码器，比 LeWM 提升 4.1%；并将评估时域扩展至 50 步，是原始 25 步的两倍，验证长时程泛化能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 MemWM，一种关联记忆增强的潜世界模型，通过内容寻址记忆库和自适应层归一化，结合低层动作条件动力学，并在共享潜空间中利用互补损失防止记忆槽坍缩。
analysis.method: 关联记忆增强的潜世界模型，将 JEPA 风格预测与内容寻址记忆库结合，通过自适应层归一化利用高层历史表征条件化预测，并引入两个互补损失鼓励记忆槽多样性和时间步均衡利用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种关联记忆增强的潜世界模型 MemWM，通过记忆库与自适应层归一化提升长时程任务中的规划性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文属于世界模型（World Model）研究，直接面向机器人学习中的环境建模与规划，与机器人动作预测和操控任务高度相关。其为复杂环境提供高效的长时程世界模型，可辅助 VLA 系统的规划能力，但未直接涉及 VLA 或 WAM 架构。

papers.abstract: Portable mobile-manipulation demonstrations can help alleviate data scarcity for embodied intelligence, but obtaining reliable, low-cost, and robot-free motion supervision from RGB observations remains challenging. Existing approaches often rely on teleoperation or specialized devices equipped with additional sensing hardware, while directly using estimated visual odometry (VO) trajectories can introduce inconsistencies due to accumulated drift and imperfect motion supervision. We present the Visual-Odometry-Conditioned Mobile Manipulation Interface (VOMMI), a portable demonstration collection and learning framework that connects portable RGB demonstrations to vision-language-action (VLA) post-training through offline trajectory reconstruction and online visual-motion conditioning. VOMMI synchronizes body and hand views to capture navigation context and local object interactions without requiring human-robot kinematic correspondence calibration. R2-VO refines offline demonstration trajectories using sparse geometric anchors and produces causal local-motion tokens over multiple prediction horizons for online policy conditioning. An action-group residual adapter incorporates these tokens only into the base branch. Experiments use a 500-trajectory portable for each task, with 75 trajectories held out for RGB-VO evaluation, and 200 robot demonstrations as references. Our policy, post-trained only on portable demonstrations, achieves 18.2% lower base-velocity error than a policy trained with robot-collected demonstrations, while maintaining comparable end-effector translation accuracy. Offline reconstruction reduces absolute trajectory errors for the body and hand streams by 24.6% on average relative to the best evaluated baseline for each stream. The complete system improves the mean success rate by 8.3 percentage points over OpenPI 0.5 across three real-robot tasks.

analysis.key_results: 在500条便携轨迹上训练的策略比机器人采集演示训练的策略基础速度误差降低18.2%；离线重建将身体和手部轨迹的绝对误差平均降低24.6%；真实机器人任务上平均成功率比OpenPI 0.5提高8.3个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种便携式演示收集与学习框架VOMMI，利用RGB观测和视觉里程计（VO）信息，无需机器人运动学标定即可收集数据，并通过轨迹重建和在线视觉-运动条件化将便携演示用于VLA后训练。
analysis.method: 同步身体与手部视角捕获导航和交互信息；R2-VO利用稀疏几何锚点优化离线轨迹并生成因果局部运动token；动作组残差适配器将这些token仅注入基础分支。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出VOMMI框架，通过视觉里程计条件化的便携式演示收集和学习，连接RGB演示与VLA后训练，提升移动操作策略性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对VLA模型的数据采集与后训练问题，提出利用便携式RGB演示和视觉里程计条件化来提升移动操作VLA策略，属于VLA与机器人学习领域的核心研究。

papers.abstract: Recent advances in video generative models have enabled high-fidelity, temporally coherent video generation. However, these models often struggle to satisfy prompts requiring specialized knowledge, specific identities, physical consistency, or ordered events. In this paper, we present VideoGen-Agent, a multimodal agent trained through multitask agentic reinforcement learning to use external tools for video generation. The agent coordinates augmentation, generation, and verification tools through multi-turn interactions, using the prompt and intermediate observations to guide its decisions. We train a shared policy on a category-balanced dataset spanning six tasks. Supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated trajectories establishes tool-use behavior, which is then refined through reinforcement learning. A category-aware hybrid reward evaluates tool-call validity, task-appropriate tool use, and generated video quality. We further introduce VABench, a held-out benchmark of 600 prompts covering procedural knowledge, single- and multi-entity identity preservation, physical consistency, scene composition, and multi-shot temporal structure. On VABench, VideoGen-Agent improves over its base text-to-video generator by 19.1 points, from 56.5 to 75.6. Upgrading the generation tools further raises the score to 86.1 without additional agent training. Human raters prefer the upgraded configuration over the strongest standalone baseline in 84.3% of comparisons. These results support learning tool use across video-generation tasks and show that the trained agent can benefit from subsequent advances in generation tools. Project page: https://andyca111.github.io/VideoGen_Agent/

analysis.key_results: 在VABench上，VideoGen-Agent比基础文本到视频生成器提高19.1分（从56.5到75.6）；升级生成工具后达到86.1分，无需额外训练；人类评估中84.3%比较优于最强基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出多模态智能体VideoGen-Agent，通过多任务智能体强化学习协调多种工具来改进视频生成，并构建了VABench基准以评估工具使用能力。
analysis.method: 使用监督微调初始化工具使用行为，再通过多任务智能体强化学习进行优化；采用类别感知的混合奖励评估工具调用有效性和生成视频质量。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出一种多模态智能体VideoGen-Agent，通过多任务智能体强化学习使用外部工具来增强视频生成，并引入VABench基准测试。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于视频生成智能体，不直接涉及VLA或机器人世界模型。然而其工具使用和改进生成质量的方法可能对构建机器人世界模型有启发，但无明确关联。

papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation, requiring robots to regulate not only motion but also how they yield to external forces, has emerged as the next frontier for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, existing VLAs output purely kinematic commands, degrading performance on real-world contact-rich tasks. In this paper, we introduce CompVLA, a unified VLA framework that jointly predicts motion and a stiffness matrix from RGB and language inputs. Our approach augments the conventional architecture with a dedicated Compliance Expert, which outputs time-varying stiffness and virtual displacement profiles executed via geometric impedance control. We demonstrate that CompVLA achieves the highest average success rate across diverse contact-rich tasks, outperforming both vanilla and compliance-aware VLA baselines, with ablations confirming each component is essential.

analysis.key_results: CompVLA 在多种接触丰富任务上取得最高平均成功率，优于普通和顺应性感知的 VLA 基线；消融实验证实每个组件都至关重要。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 CompVLA 框架，联合预测运动指令和时变刚度矩阵，并通过专用的 Compliance Expert 输出刚度与虚拟位移剖面，实现可变顺应性控制。
analysis.method: 在传统 VLA 架构上增加 Compliance Expert，从 RGB 和语言输入同时预测运动轨迹和刚度矩阵，并利用几何阻抗控制执行时变刚度与虚拟位移剖面。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CompVLA 是一个统一的 VLA 框架，通过同时预测运动和刚度矩阵并结合几何阻抗控制，解决了现有 VLA 在真实接触丰富任务中仅输出运动学指令导致性能下降的问题。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接以 VLA 为核心，针对接触丰富操作任务提出可变顺应性建模与执行方法，与本站 VLA 主题高度契合，尤其对机器人操作中的力控制与动作生成具有重要参考价值。

papers.abstract: Diffusion policies have shown strong potential for robotic imitation learning, and recent extensions incorporate additional modalities to improve manipulation performance. However, these modalities often differ not only in information content but also in sensing rates and inference latencies. Existing multimodal diffusion policies typically rely on synchronous fusion or manually designed multi-frequency architectures, which either slow down high-frequency feedback or limit extensibility to new modality combinations. We propose LAG-Fusion, a latency-aware guidance fusion framework for asynchronous multimodal diffusion policy composition. LAG-Fusion allows modality-specific policies to operate at their native inference rates and contribute denoising guidance whenever available. To make asynchronous composition consistent, we derive a reference-frame rebasing rule for diffusion variables under relative action representations, enabling delayed guidance to be aligned before fusion. We instantiate LAG-Fusion in contact-rich manipulation by composing a low-frequency vision policy with a high-frequency force policy. Experiments under heterogeneous modality latencies show that LAG-Fusion improves policy responsiveness and task performance over synchronous fusion and specially designed force-aware baselines.

analysis.key_results: 在异质模态延迟下，LAG-Fusion 相比同步融合和专门设计的力感知基线，提升了策略响应性和任务性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 LAG-Fusion：一种面向异步多模态扩散策略组合的延迟感知引导融合框架，支持不同模态策略按原生速率运行并实现延迟引导对齐。
analysis.method: 基于参考帧重基准规则对齐异步引导，并组合低频视觉策略与高频力策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 LAG-Fusion 框架，使多模态扩散策略能按各自原生速率异步运行并利用延迟引导对齐进行融合，以提升接触丰富操作任务的响应性和性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本工作直接面向机器人多模态策略学习，处理视觉与力觉等模态的异步融合问题，对 VLA 策略的高效推理和异步传感器集成具有直接参考价值。

figures.caption: MATE enables modular, rate-preserving policy composition. (Left) We organize representative manipulation methods along two complementary properties: modularity and rate preservation . (A) Unified policies are neither modular nor rate-preserving. (B) Slow-fast and hierarchical methods preserve heterogeneous rates but rely on coupled architectures. (C) Modular composition methods combine independently trained components but synchronize them at a shared inference rate. (D) MATE achieves both properties through asynchronous multi-rate policy composition. (Right) As a motivating experiment, we evaluate a standalone force policy on the Flip task across five different objects, with the gripper initialized near the object in a pre-contact configuration. Higher policy inference rates consistently improve task success, motivating the need to preserve heterogeneous inference rates during policy composition.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of the MATE Framework. MATE asynchronously composes component diffusion policies operating at heterogeneous inference rates. (Left) We illustrate vision-force composition as an example, where a lower-rate vision-conditioned policy provides long-horizon scene guidance and a higher-rate force-conditioned policy provides local contact guidance. (Right) In the diffusion composition head, the overlapping noisy action segment is rebased into the current force frame for force denoising. The corresponding vision guidance is rebased to the same frame, fused with force guidance, and mapped back to update the full-horizon noise prediction.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve state-of-the-art image generation quality but incur substantial memory and computational costs at inference. While aggressive Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) to 4-bit precision offers significant efficiency gains, it typically results in severe quality degradation. Existing approaches, including smoothing-based methods, mixed-precision schemes, rotation techniques, and low-rank residual methods, partially mitigate this issue but still leave a noticeable gap to FP16/BF16 performance. In this work, we introduce DiRotQ, a W4A4 PTQ framework that mitigates this degradation through rotation-aware activation quantization. DiRotQ identifies a low-rank subspace capturing dominant activation variance via Principal Component Analysis (PCA), preserving coefficients in this subspace at higher precision while quantizing the remaining components to 4-bit. Activations are rotated into the PCA basis at inference time using calibration-derived orthogonal transformations, while the inverse rotation is fused into the layer weights offline. Combined with GPTQ-based weight quantization, DiRotQ achieves an FID of 15.9 and PSNR of 19.1 dB on PixArt over the MJHQ-30K dataset, outperforming the prior state-of-the-art SVDQuant (FID 18.9, PSNR 17.6) under the same INT W4A4 setting. Beyond standard metrics, we introduce a VLM-as-a-Judge evaluation protocol for diffusion model quantization, the first such evaluation in this setting, providing a more holistic assessment of perceptual quality and prompt alignment under aggressive compression. On the systems side, our Triton-based custom kernel enables efficient end-to-end inference, reducing memory usage of the 12B FLUX.1-dev model by 2.1x and achieving a 2.3x speedup over BF16 on an RTX 4090. On the RTX PRO 6000 with Blackwell architecture, DiRotQ achieves a 2.0x speedup and memory reduction over BF16 using NVFP4.

analysis.key_results: 在PixArt上，MJHQ-30K数据集下FID为15.9，PSNR为19.1 dB，优于SVDQuant（FID 18.9，PSNR 17.6）；对FLUX.1-dev 12B模型，Triton内核实现内存减少2.1倍，RTX 4090上相比BF16加速2.3倍；在RTX PRO 6000（Blackwell架构）上使用NVFP4实现2.0倍加速与内存降低。
analysis.main_contribution: DiRotQ框架：利用PCA识别激活方差主导的低秩子空间，在该子空间内保留更高精度，其余成分量化为4位，并将逆旋转融合到层权重中，结合GPTQ权重量化，在W4A4设置下实现领先的图像生成质量和系统效率。
analysis.method: 旋转感知激活量化：基于PCA的低秩子空间分解与混合精度量化，激活在推理时经校准得到的正交旋转矩阵投影到PCA基，逆旋转离线融合进权重，并结合GPTQ权重量化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出DiRotQ，一种W4A4后训练量化框架，通过旋转感知激活量化缓解扩散Transformer在4位量化下的质量退化。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 无直接关系。该论文专注于扩散Transformer模型的量化推理效率，不涉及VLA、WAM或机器人策略学习。但其量化方法可潜在应用于基于扩散的机器人世界模型或策略网络，具有间接的参考价值。
